<BigEm>EQUIPMENT</> is an additional tool you carry in missions which can trigger various effects. It ranges from throwable items like grenades, self-buffs for various stats to devices that disable electronics.

Each character carries a single piece of equipment you can use by pressing <action id="Ability1"/>. Holding the button with long-range gadgets displays a throw trajectory you can use to help you aim.

Equipment can typically be used again after its cooldown elapses, although certain items are instead recharged with enemy kills.

<BigEm>HEALTH</> represents the amount of damage a character can take and still continue fighting.

After taking damage, your health will start regenerating after a delay as long as you avoid further injuries.

When your health first drops to zero, you fall to the <Italic>downstate</>, and another member of your team must come to revive you – otherwise, you’ll soon die. This action will cost you one <BigEm>REVIVE</>. Every character has a certain number of revives, which can be further increased with perks.

If your health drops to zero and you have no revives left (or there’s nobody left to revive you), you will die. Certain sources of damage will kill you no matter what, such as falling from a great height.

<BigEm>MISSIONS</> are the bread and butter of your operation. Assemble your team of up to four players to steal loot, dispose of enemies, sneak undetected or dish out heavy gunfire.

Successful missions are rewarded with cash and experience based on the final rating between one and three stars.
• The first star is given for a successful mission
• The second star comes from <Italic>clean execution</>; finishing without killing civilians or dead team members
• The third star is awarded for completing the optional bonus objective

If it seems your mission is going south, you can <Italic>restart</> it from the pause menu.

<BigEm>PERKS</> are passive bonuses that improve your character’s default stats. They come in three tiers, but a character can equip each perk only once.

Every character comes with a default <Italic>class perk</>, which determines the base stats of a character, and up to three perks that offer further boosts.

Picking the correct set of perks for the situation can greatly affect your chances of completing a mission.

You can select and upgrade perks of the <Italic>Boss</>, while other characters come with a fixed set. Perks of campaign characters are added and upgraded during promotions.

<BigEm>STEALTH</> represents the initial phase of most missions in which you are hidden and attract no attention from police forces and gangsters alike.

Committing actions like taking down guards, breaking cameras, trespassing, or simply behaving suspiciously (running, jumping, crouching in the vicinity of guards) will give you a <BigEm>STRIKE</>. Accumulating three strikes fails stealth, the police are called, and the mission continues in combat.
Certain actions go beyond mere suspicion, and guards will call the police immediately after witnessing evidence of crimes. Examples include seeing weapons, hearing gunshots, finding trespassers in restricted areas or encountering dead bodies or stolen goods.

Once stealth is broken, the mission has to be finished in combat, with an increasingly strong police response.

Each character comes equipped with three <BigEm>WEAPONS</>.

<Italic>Primary weapon</> is your heavy hitter, best suited for the heat of combat.

<Italic>Secondary weapon</> is your supporting firearm, trading fire rate and damage for precision. When you carry multiple loot bags, only this weapon can be used.

<Italic>Melee weapon</> can turn the flow of combat when you get surrounded by enemies at close range. Or when you prefer a stealthier approach.

Missions can be started in three <BigEm>DIFFICULTIES</>. 

Higher difficulties bring a tougher challenge in exchange for increased reward.

In stealth, enemies become more perceptive and react faster. Pings have a limited duration and count. Civilians flee faster. More loot bags are needed to finish a mission.

Once combat breaks, enemies inflict more damage and become more aggressive. Your health and regeneration are slightly reduced. The police begin with more badges, which affects the enemy type and intensity of response.

No Boss can pull off a heist all alone.

Up to four characters can form a <BigEm>TEAM</> and participate on a mission. Team members can assist with their own unique approach, loadout and perks. They may revive fallen teammates and assist in coordinated actions. Having more human players increases the reward, but may also affect difficulty.
There are no penalties for taking bots, so it’s advisable to fill the free slots with the extra help, unless you fancy a challenge.

Pressing <action id="WheelMenu"/> opens the <BigEm>CHAT WHEEL</> that you can use to communicate with others. From there, you may also access the <BigEm>BOT WHEEL</> to command bots. When playing alone, you may <Italic>switch</> between any available bots and play as them.

Not all valuables can be grabbed straight off the shelves. Truly valuable loot tends to be kept behind a slew of security measures.

Crates, display cases and the like can typically be broken into with <action id="Bash"/>.

Simple locked doors and containers can be <BigEm>LOCKPICKED</>. When lockpicking, turn the lock until the pins align with the middle point, and after aligning them all, the lock opens. Secure doors may instead require finding the access keycard or a keypad code.

When all else fails, few doors resists being drilled into or sawed through.

Off-limit locations are often monitored by <BigEm>CAMERAS</>. Crimes witnessed through them are reported to the authorities. As with guards, there is a brief grace period to act before a crime is reported; however, broken cameras raise suspicion and will cause a <Italic>strike</>.

Individual cameras can be temporarily disabled on the spot with specialized equipment.

The camera system is operated from the <Italic>security office</> via a <BigEm>SECURITY MONITOR</>, which can be used to inspect the surroundings through available cameras, or disable them all for good.

Pressing <action id="Ping"/> <BigEm>HIGHLIGHTS</> an object you’re looking at for you and your teammates. You can use this to keep track of cameras and enemies (even as they walk behind obstacles) or point out places of interest.

Holding the button with bots on your team may be used to issue <BigEm>BOT COMMANDS</>. Different commands are available depending on the situation.
Bots may be ordered to <Icon>ĕ</><Bold>Subdue</> enemies, <Icon>[</><Bold>Defend</> an area, <Icon>A</><Bold>Loot</> valuables and many more context-specific actions.

The key to a successful stealth approach is awareness of one’s surroundings, civilians and patrolling enemies.

<Italic>Civilians</> will flee to safety and report crimes they witness. You can <BigEm>INTIMIDATE</> one or multiple civilians with <action id="Shout"/>. Avoid harming civilians, as that fails <Italic>clean execution</> and lowers your overall mission reward.

Approaching patrolling enemies or civilians from the back before they notice you allows you to silently <BigEm>SUBDUE</> them.

Subdued or intimidated targets can be <BigEm>ZIP-TIED</> to prevent them from running away and moved to a more convenient location.

A party boy with a knack for business. 
He may seem to take nothing seriously and certainly enjoys the pleasures of life, but don't be fooled – his jovial demeanor hides a shrewd mind of a capable leader.

A small time drug kingpin who arrived in the city in order to expand his business, now given a chance of his wildest dreams to usurp the entire city for himself. 
Fortune favors the bold, but then again, so does the morgue.
After sending people to a mission, they need to rest until the next day, making them unavailable. End the day to refresh them.

An alleged descendant of the Great Genghis Khan, Khan wants to rule everything in sight with his mighty biker gang Riders. 
Tough and rough, with no mercy for those who cross his path on his conquest of Rockay City.

Army capacity shows the maximum number of soldiers that you are able to hire, and increases with the boss’s respect. However, you may get soldiers above your current army capacity from capturing turfs and random events.

As the former right-hand man of the late King, Dollar Dragon seeks to avenge his boss’s death and restore the former order. 
He’s an old-school, reasonable man – but he’s got no patience to tolerate anyone’s nonsense.
Cagnali inherited her father's small toolshop in her early years, transforming it from a village family business into an international conglomerate. Her intelligence is not to be underestimated.
Certain missions require a specific person to be started. Everyone’s gotta get their hands dirty.
Even the best boss needs to sleep sometimes. Tomorrow, your underlings will be refreshed and the story will progress.
Even the markets of the criminal world live by supply and demand. The price of loot gradually changes, and sometimes it pays off to hold onto your loot just a little bit longer.
Everyone has certain special skills, and your entourage is full of uniquely talented people. Take note of their abilities and who will be most effective in helping you secure the crown.
Here you can adjust your lobby's privacy settings. Public lobbies will be visible to everyone in the session browser unlike private lobbies – but your friends can be invited to either.
Here you can outfit your team with new weapons and equipment. Unlocking the gun trade allows the purchase of more advanced weaponry for your arsenal.
If you don’t like the daily selection of recruits or weapons, you can roll the dice and get a new batch; however, the price to refresh will increase until it’s reset the next day.
If you don’t like the selection of recruits for hire, you can roll the dice and meet a new batch; however, the price to refresh will increase until it’s reset the next day.
If you’re running low on cash, see your local loan shark. Be warned though, their exorbitant interest rates will cost you dearly.

King is the leader of the city’s underground, and de facto ruler of the entire Rockay. 
No crime happens without his consent and a hefty cut, and the police don’t dare to even sneeze without his approval. Even the mayor is on board, because even though crime is rampant, the city enjoys an unprecedented era of stability.
List of income, expenses and the total balance for the current day. Positive balance means you did well today.
Missing: When jobs go south, teammates can turn up missing. They may find their own way back, require a daring rescue… or never be heard from again.
Missions may have a special objective whose completion affects your final reward.

Pick a goal to take the next step in your criminal career. Completing goals advances the story, leads to new missions and vast rewards.
Professionals don’t leave tracks. Civilian casualties and dead team members leave a trail of evidence which can land you in prison. Be careful.
Ready soldiers are those you can still use today. All soldiers in your army refresh each day.
Resting: Team members sent on missions need time to rest. They will be available again the following day.
Select how much you want to sell and hit the button. Be conservative – loot can sometimes be used for a purpose other than fast cash.

Sheriff Norris is out to dismantle gangs like ours. Back to back jobs will raise the heat but lie low for a day and the cops will cool off.
However, his investigation will persist and once its complete, well… game over.
Soldiers sent to capture turfs or to partake in other activities will not be available until the next day.
The weapon selection for the day can be refreshed for a price, but the cost goes up every time until the following day.
There’s safety in numbers. For most missions, you can assign multiple characters.
This is your team led by boss Baker. They are skilled and valuable – so they only partake in heists and moneymaking missions and stay away from the brunt of the turf war conflict.
Total soldiers represent the amount of recruits you currently have in your army, including resting.
Turf war requires a lot of muscle. That’s what your army is for. Select the amount of soldiers that will be sent to the fight here.
You can only hire soldiers once per day.
You can see what loot is in your stash and convert it to money here.
You gain experience as a Boss for winning missions with Travis Baker, buying assets and for the score achieved at the end of a campaign run.

A new, promising technology startup is looking for investors. For a portion of the newfound company’s shares, we can help the business to kick off. 
The only problem is that our investment needs to be backed by a substantial sum of gold.
An art collector promises to introduce you to the world of antique collectables if you can help him obtain a renowned art piece.
An eighteenth-century French sabre surfaced in the city. Napoleon Bonaparte bestowed it upon a soldier who proved his valor in combat.

As you're expanding your empire across the city center, which has been torn apart by the turf war, Casey sees this as an opportunity to pour some cash into a penthouse that has noticeably depreciated in value.
Casey can get you new set of wheels, the latest Torini. Make it yours by any means necessary, and make everyone jealous!
Casey received news about a rare flintlock musket that once commissioned by Louis XIV for his generals.

Snatcher is finally going public but there's a big problem to deal with first. The banker who helped us turn dirty money into investments is threatening to tell the press everything.
If we let that happen, the company is effectively dead in the water.

To cover up some of our shadier operations, we might use a legitimate business that would turn money from less-than-legal means into clean gains. One such opportunity just presented itself in the construction industry.
We have a chance to acquire a cannon from a sixteenth-century Spanish galleon that was lifted from the seabed and polished to its former beauty.

With the Snatcher stacking up to be a great success, we may benefit from obtaining an even greater share of the company. 
This time we won't need to dig through our own pockets, as long as we're able to help a friend pull a clever insurance fraud.
With the last obstacle out of the way, now is the time to set up our new construction business.
You never felt the faintest urge to drop by downstairs and play the termite-infested crumbling old piano, but maybe that would change if you had a fantastically expensive one right in your office.
A beautiful piece salvaged from the sea and nearly restored to it’s former glory.
A cabinet that puts your uncompromising side on display, featuring the most impressive-looking weapons in your arsenal, even if they may not be the most effective. Show them who the Boss is.
A club original, carefully restored as a reminder that quality lasts.
A collection of football memorabilia featuring items from past victors of Rockay City, one from each team.
A conversation piece and a warning. Perfect.
A cowboy running a city still grabs life by the horns, but he keeps the gold on the bull skull and off the streets.
A deep blue ceramic vase, valued both in terms of cash and emotional attachment. Breaks very easily…
A due reminder, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and all empires fall.
A four-inch refracting telescope, used purely for display purposes, sits unused. After all, why look up at the stars when all a man could ever desire can be found right here?
A gourmet bottle of ketchup for the most demanding connoisseurs. Matured in oak caskets in Himalayan mountains, brought to you on the wings of swans. The very sauce of a true crime boss.
A grand statue of Lady Justice, draped in flowing robes, imposing and divine. May she ever turn a blind eye.
A hefty diving helmet made of solid inch-thick metal, though it hasn’t been used in quite some time.
A king needs a blade to name his knights.
A king needs a blade to name his knights… or a pair to settle questions of honor.
A legitimate business for income, and a handy way to dispose of evidence.
A lifetime supply of the finest cigars money can buy. Smokes like victory.
A loyal companion who patiently balances your bottles on its head all day long.
A luxurious dressing table, engraved with brass decorations and intricate designs. Whoever put this place together had style and class.
A memento of a big win on the courts.
A painting you stole from the art gallery to pass to an art collector.
A reminder that most problems can be solved with a liberal application of superior firepower.
A showcase of various expensive art pieces from your collection, all proudly on display. Beauty available for the eye to behold.

A small paradise that you can call your own, tucked away in a hidden corner of the world.
No man is an island, but it’s certainly amazing to be able to own one.
A striking ceremonial mask from a foreign tribe.
A striking ceremonial mask from the motherland.
A tanto to really tie the room together.
A toast for a job well done, or a salve for a bitter loss.
A vintage brass gramophone, with a fragile and delicate design, sits in your collection. You have a record ready to play on it on the day you take over Rockay.
A wooden closet, old-fashioned and filled with dusty tomes, with a faint sense of vellichor. Knowledge is power, and it classes up the joint.
A world-renowned symbol of wealth and status sent as a peace offering from a beleaguered would-be conqueror.

After sealing the largest gold trade in world history, Baba Falcoon offered to provide refuge should you ever need it. One thing every smart desperado needs, is a bolt hole… or in this case a Bolt-Island.
An antique globe to keep perspective with a hiding hole for the good stuff.
An antique wooden armoire, overflowing with musty old volumes and a feeling of times forgotten.
An auburn ceramic vase, you were assured, is absolutely indestructible by any conventional means. Only one way to find out…
An award from one of the greatest conquerors of modern military for valor in combat still has it’s edge.

An enormous mound of treasure, far surpassing the gold reserves of many a small country – enough to last several lifetimes, or just one lived to the fullest.
Going to have to rename the club “Little Knox”.
An iconic blade deserving a fancy stand.
An incredible container of unparalleled design, an object of desire and destiny outdone only by the wondrous nature of its indescribable contents.
Documentation of a majority shareholding in a moderately questionable technology enterprise.
Documentation of a small stake in a tech startup.
Far from nice but nice from afar.
High quality communications, best way to make sure you’re connected.
Home is where the heart is, and the current chaos has left this palatial penthouse open, available, and surprisingly affordable.
Home team advantage displayed for all to recognize.
Is it modern? Is it art? Whatever, it’s cool as hell.
It ain’t much to look at but the bones are still solid.
It’s history as bloody as it’s remarkable coloring, this beautiful bauble is a spoil of war that stuns all who view it.
It’s not a car, it’s a statement. This one of a kind marvel of Italian engineering is worth every penny, and every drop of blood and sweat shed in its acquisition.
Keep your drinks, your ash, and heck, even your boots off the floor.

Many a painter will remember having their would-be magnum opus ruined by poor handling. Not with this easel, which not only opens the door to the world of pretentious art, but also makes it appear to the untrained eye that you’re a painter yourself.
One of a set of twelve antique firearms, commissioned by “The Sun King” for his most trusted followers.
Ownership of a new and growing technology giant.
Priceless pristine pottery, probably perfectly perdurable.
Regaled by Russian royalty, caviar is truly a delicious delight. Appropriated while seeking other goods on Khan’s ship. Excellent for trade, or for your own regal reception.
Some blokes will trade anything for a bump.
Sometimes taking your work home means stacks of more gold than most ever can dream of.
The crown jewel of a former heir ascending. Collected as revenge for revealed trespasses.
The king of the jungle, to guard your contracts from ill winds.
The only thing better than one iconic blade is two.
The road to rulership requires more than the physical arts of war. This figurine affords the astute viewer to know its owner is a not just a man of action but a thinker as well.
The spoils from your visit to the gold depot – few dare dream of such lavish fortune, but now it’s all yours.
The spoils from your visit to the gold depot – few dare dream of such lavish fortune, but now it’s all yours. It's enough to last several lifetimes, or just one, lived to the fullest.
There is traveling in style. And then there is traveling with a pile of gold so large, you barely make your weight clearance.
These sensational sculptures are near mythological examples of Eastern occultism. Mere possession of these magnificent masterpieces is said to set the owner on a path to preeminence.

This DuzzelDorfer is one of only four of its kind in the continental United States. The distinctive sound is music from heaven. The satisfaction of owning such a revered treasure… well, that is for you to decide.
This bottle of condiment was the first thing you found in the storage when you purchased the club, and now can’t bring yourself to throw away. It brings you good luck. And keeps your fries tasty.
To get where you want to go it helps to know where you’ve been. This vintage camera illustrates a firm foundation of what came before.
What’s a big city without bright lights?
You have to spend money to make money. In this case, the luxury hotel was the cost for access to a literal metric ton of gold.
You’ve transformed what was once nearly a ruin into a masterpiece, shaping it to your vision and raising it to perfection. A club fit for a king.

You grew-up with this tough-as-nails son of a bitch, NFL hall-of-famer, and war vet. Champion, Coach, and completely fucking crazy.

The man with the master-plan, knows Rockay like the back of his hand. Put Gloves on – and your hands stay clean.

Organized and sly. Nasara brings you unique talent. He handles your distribution, loot, and a hell of a lot more. Brought in by Casey, this former naval officer washed up on the Rocky City beach – with a knife in his back. A sole survivor of his shipwreck.

You’re a badass charmer from the wrong side of the tracks. Keep on rocking your way through Rockay – and you’ll get some boss-worthy bonuses coming your way.

Not afraid to mix it up with whoever wants to rumble, you came to Rockay City to sling party pills into the rave scene. Then BOOM! – the reigning Crime Boss gets blown to bits. Now’s your chance to switch your nickname from Candyman to The King.

A brilliant engineer and an honorable protector of his family, which for this awesome aural architect, causes a dynamic descent onto the boomy byways of Rockay City. An honest man with a difficult plan, Shivaji Kumar is ever a man of his word, and the word of the day is CRIME.

A certified genius when it comes to computers, technology… and everything else if you ask him, more than likely even if you don’t. Humberto Wamba or “Wiz” as he calls himself, is The Man, or so he claims. His lifelong streak of bad luck is solely due to his associations. If he could only find competent underlings, ahem collaborators, Wiz (and they) could run the world… straight off a cliff. But technology and computers are the future, and he swears you can trust him on this!

A man of few words, but at his size he doesn’t need them. The man called Tuna can be found beside the doormen of the hottest spots in town. As good as he is at protecting doors, he is far better at breaking them down. The very definition of muscle for hire, Tuna is a force of nature when he takes the job, as there are few willing or stupid enough to try and stop him.

A party boy with a knack for business. Earned his nickname as a child by selling iced water at the height of summer to thirsty folks, and gave in to the allure of the big city which offered vastly more opportunities to succeed. 

A jack of all trades who takes nothing seriously and enjoys the pleasures of life, but his jovial demeanor hides a shrewd mind of a capable leader.

A single blossom found upon the body. They know he did it. They are certain it was him, but nothing on the scene tangibly connects the man with the flower of the same name left behind. This debonair French Florist known only as Tulip is widely thought to be an Assassin bar none. But the only ones who can confirm it… lie cold with a flower on their corpse.

A small-time drug dealer who arrived into the Rockay City to expand his business. Travis Baker longs for the opportunity to meet with the King of the criminal underworld to receive his blessing to start selling his special brand of blue candy large-scale. And such opportunity may soon come to be.

Alexandros Richards called “X” by all, has come to Rockay seeking answers. This expert operator is none too particular about who he has to go through to get them. Rockay was once home for him and his, but no longer. He has traveled the roughest parts of the world learning all the skills he needs to find out why.
An old-school, reasonable man who held significant influence in the city for way longer than anyone else alive – and he's got no patience left to tolerate anyone’s nonsense.

Dishonorably discharged and imprisoned for acting on bad intel, Nigel Thorne, a once respected SAS member, has found a base of operations in the action-filled streets of Rockay City. Cracker utilizes the readily available criminal elements to stay sharp, and build his network, preparing for the day that he gets the location of those who betrayed him…
From ground zero to the gridiron, this halfback should have been in the Hall of Fame. A forced early retirement sent Troy Dalton from the stadium to the streets.

Gustav Bruckner was born on the wrong side of the bedsheets, literally. This sour sharpshooter acts as if the world is out to get him, because it is. If being in the wrong place at the wrong time was a skill, Peak would get top marks. But Peak is tired of being destiny’s whipping boy and in Rockay, he aims to bring all his troubles to their climax.

Hailing directly from Eire and born for the boxing ring, Romy O’Neil aka “Ropes” received a one-way ticket to Rockay City when he applied a little too much street justice to the wrong man. But it ain’t all sour grapes as the city provides better weather, better opportunities, and better scenery… Now all Ropes needs is better luck!

However a devil he is behind the wheel, life won’t let Enrique Dirangen keep his hellfire on the asphalt. Beset on all sides by avatars of the underworld, try as he might, this wily wheelster seems destined to use his endless drive… in pursuit of crime.
Jack of all trades. He can do a bit of everything but otherwise has no special talent of his own.
Jack of all trades. She can do a bit of everything but otherwise has no special talent of her own.

Johan Sommer is a true composer of orchestrated chaos. This sinister virtuoso of violence is equal parts hedonist and psycho-killer, bound only to his hidden agenda and even more secretive masters. Why he is in Rockay and for what will certainly be a symphony of destruction.

Jupiter has earned her moniker! She has completed her father’s work and has synthesized a new and highly effective performance enhancer. She can now carry up to three bags and fistfight a bear if the need arises.

Ladislav wants nothing more than to be an action hero! He’s come to Rockay to live the thrills and solidify the skills needed to be a box office big shot. But the hero's journey is not for everyone, and he’ll find plenty of fun and funds in the roughshod role as the rapscallion.

Marie Chambernet has an arsenal of assets, and this savvy seductress knows how to work them all. To solve her need for speed, she capitalizes on the greed that so many have for the finer things in life. But all too often greed goes too far, so our lady had to go from the city of lights to Rockay nights.

Mother knows best! Theresa Flowers has devoted her life to the lost. The streets of Rockay are no place for kids to play. Pontification and paperwork provide neither food nor shelter, and with time running out, Mother has the will to do whatever it takes to make a space for those the system has left behind.

Nigel Thorne, a former SAS operative, is the ultimate shadow in Rockay’s criminal underworld. Lethal at any range, he blends stealth, savage close combat, and pinpoint accuracy. His “SAS Instinct” enables him to sense enemy positions, making him a ghostly predator who turns any battleground into his personal playground of controlled chaos.

Ninja by night, Sean-Shiro Matsuda has come to Rockay for one thing…WAR. But the Ninja always strike from the shadows. Mild mannered cabbie by day, this certified shinobi spends his nights earning coin and collecting coups, methodically dismantling the clan that dares to dishonor their sacred traditions.

Sonia Sanchez is a haughty hematopathologist. In her quest to be the best, she turns to those prone to frequently needing medical attention, and little recourse for questionable reactions. This second-generation medical marvel is determined to conquer death itself! And with the wild ways of Rockay, bodies with which to play are easy to come by.

The man to call if you want something moved… including bodies. Charles Henry Esson the third was cursed by the Witch he was hired to kill. Now this Shotta finds himself in play on the crazy streets of Rockay. Out of his element and under siege by his own senses, he works the scene to gain the means to find the witch, take her down, and break the curse once and for all.

This tough as nails Vietnam vet knows only the cold comfort of spitting hot lead, or that of the government sanctioned drugs that keep him, what they like to call, functioning. Still, a warrior born in the action-filled streets will not long be able to resist the call. As they say violence isn’t the answer, violence is the question and the answer is YES!

Tomorrow is not a promise, and nobody knows this better than Kadee Garimara. This former socialite learned the hard way that fortune can turn on a dime, and is determined to make the most of the only true commodity one has. Time.
Weapon specialist through and through. You can count on her in any fight.
Weapon specialist through and through. You can count on him in any fight.

What he lacks in stature he more than makes up for in personality, and loyalty, often to a fault. Franco Mesce-Bertrand is a perfect gentleman to the ladies, and an unshakeable ally to his employer. But some allies go too far and Stinger’s exile to Rockay from The Big City is a direct result of his aggressive defense activities.

When Mr. Roberts started with his lucrative janitor gig in late King's high-security gold depository, he knew he made himself a target for all wannabee treasure hunters who seek a way in.
Then finally, Travis Baker gave him an offer he couldn't refuse – a ton of money.

Whether it’s playing out the point, or calculating an acid dissociation constant, Lothar Uhlig is the very definition of competence, but the line ends sharply there. Life outside of work for Forehand is a shambling mess of bad luck and worse choices, but maybe he’s bound to turn that around as he hopes to play and work his way, in Rockay.

With the name of a god amongst gods and the physique to match, Jupiter owes her incredible size to steroids, but that’s not all she gained. With an attitude that makes a mule seem reasonable, and a mouth that would make a sailor blush, her monstrous reputation is well earned. But few can match her power and tenacity when on the job.
Wiz knows he’s the best in the biz—ask him, he’ll tell you! He better dress to look the part. Inspired by his favorite rapper, Hielo—just don’t tell Baker—Wiz, too, is going for gold.

Apparently, these models are more than a bit fiercer than their SWAT and police counterparts.

Doesn’t matter, they’re all going to the same place – the scrapyard.

I don’t really know the first thing about this Servo kid, but he better pull us out of this fucking mess.

Been putting this off long enough as it is. It’s high time we got our boys some proper iron. That should make Touchdown happy – guy’s got a hard-on for lead spitters.
Cagnali Industries has been cutting into our profit margins pretty damn heavily ever since they showed up. I think we deserve a little reimbursement.

Cagnali’s setting up her tech bullshit in the city? In MY city? No, no, no, fuck that! Bringing in her robot army is one thing, but setting up shop in historical neighborhoods is something else entirely. I mean, I used to do drugs in that motel!

Servo says this is the base of the robots’ hive-mind. Well, let’s go in and give it a lobotomy.

DO NOT TOUCH!!

Note: Call my chemist and ask him what the fuck he’s cooking!

Fucking Sheriff couldn’t get the job done himself, so now he’s relying on Cagnali to pick up the slack.

On the one hand, it means he’s desperate, which is good. On the other, it means he’s willing to take some extreme measures. And if swapping out half of the Rockay PD with metal monsters ain’t drastic, I don’t know what the hell is.
Honestly, how else was that supposed to go? Breaking into the Rockay PD… THE FUCK WAS SERVO THINKING!?!

I could’ve guessed it. Cagnali’s planning to take over the city using its own police force. Fuck… IT’S GENIUS. I’d have done the same thing myself if I wasn’t in such poor standing with the local authority.

The obvious difference here is that I would turn Rockay into a scumbags’ paradise. Cagnali, on the other hand, is gonna make this town a robotic, dystopian hellscape.

NOT GONNA HAPPEN.
I do not like this woman.
I don’t know where the hell we got the money to afford some military sci-fi bullshit like this, but hey, if it messes with those damn robots, you won’t hear me complaining.

If these machines of Cagnali’s go into full production, we’re gonna run out of bullets before she runs out of her metal men. On top of that, I doubt we’ll see a lot of recruitment given our current ‘situation’.

To sum it all up: either her factory goes up in flames, or we do.
It ain’t cheap, but the good stuff never is.

Knows too much about our business. Find and kill him? Recruit? Figure out later. For now, we need him – his inside knowledge from working at Cagnali Industries is all we have to go off of at this point.

Not to mention his technical expertise; doubt anyone around here could work with the advanced stuff we’re going up against. I sure as hell can’t. So yeah, we’re stuck with the faceless fucker.

Mean, clean, fighting machines. These things being in the possession of the police is basically my worst nightmare, but if I could get my hands on one, I’d take it, too.

Key takeaway: DON’T try to fistfight.
Mine and Cagnali’s best guys going head to head. It’s sure to be one hell of a bloodbath.

Moved up from screwdrivers to humanoid foot soldiers. It’ll take a lot of guts and a lot of luck to take down this monolith.

The only way to bring down the castle with impenetrable walls is from the inside.

Sidenote: Baker Industries has a nicer ring to it.
Nice outfits, looks cool. Won’t stop some 12-guage buckshot to the face though.

One of the richest people in the country, maybe the world. And also, one of the smartest. Combine extreme wealth with extreme intelligence, a bit of evil and a big splash of control freak, and you got real recipe for disaster.

She may think she’s doing good for the world but she only does what’s good for her. A she-devil with an angel face.

Why are the pretty ones always crazy?
SOB’s are spreading like cancer and now Rockay City’s about to go terminal.
Sounds like a 12-year-old. Also, took a listen to his ‘music’ – nothing but fucking noise – no chance it’ll ever catch on. Kid’s talented at the tech shit, he should stick with that.

Sure hope whatever we find is scandalous. Illicit photos, unsavory text messages… plans for a coup of the local government, whatever.

Find some dirt on an esteemed woman like Cagnali, and she’s bound to squirm.
These guys got themselves stuck in the shit and now it’s up to us to pull them out. What the fuck do I pay them for?!

Well… guess there’s nothing left to do but throw whatever we’ve got left at this bitch. Good.

Open air, head-to-head, anything-goes street warfare. I’m about to go Napoleonic on her ass.
What an ugly hunk of concrete. If I had the plastic to do it, I’d just blow the whole damn building down.

You know, when I got into this game, I was just boosting cars and slinging dope. Spent the better part of my life trying to avoid ending up in the police station, successfully for the most part.

And now I find myself planning to break into one… funny how life comes full circle like that, ain’t it?

Alright, we’re fucking ready.

Get out of the crates in the basement. Override security measures in the control room. Disable the security and open the cages. Then we- GET. THAT. GOLD.

And vanish like goddamn Houdini…

Can’t believe this shit. King’s influence over Rockay can be felt even after his chair blew up. Seems like Dragon found him a cozy place to rest in peace, under a fake name and with heavy security. Well, he won’t be in peace for much longer – 'cause we really need that hand of his.

I ain’t no grave-robber, but a boss' gotta do what he’s gotta do.

I’m sure as hell glad he didn’t get cremated.

Can’t use regular trucks, gotta have strengthened suspension and shit. ‘Least that’s what Gloves tells me. Might be he’s just shakin' me for money, that old dog.

…Gotta ask Nasara about it.

God knows what they usually ship in these crates, but this time it’ll be us. We get in, get transported right through the security check-ups and then take over the depot from the inside.

Now I ain’t saying it’ll be easy, but if it ain’t goddamn beautiful.

Sure as hell hope there’ll be enough oxygen.

Hope nobody on my crew’s afraid of heights. I sure as hell ain’t! Most of the time.

Gotta buy a few gliders, silently fly to the depot’s roof and boom – easy access.

The timing’s gonna have to be precise. The guards are gonna change shifts and leave the doors open for a little while – a window big enough for us to enter the depot with no trouble.

It’s time. Everything’s ready to pull the most stylish heist in history of Rockay.

We fly to the roof just as the guards are changing shifts. Sneak inside and override the security in the control room. Disable electricity and shit. Open cages, get the gold, and get the fuck out.

Here’s hopin' everything goes smooth…

I’m fucking tired of buzzsaws and drills. Wish we could just blow shit up, get the loot and scram.

Luckily we’ll need a fuck-ton of explosives for this job. If shit goes south, we’ll have to use these “un-elegant“ tools, as Nasara would say.

King's dead. What else to say?

I’m coming after everything he had. And I’ll take it all.

Black market commerce. Drug deals. Politics. He had every dirty motherfucker in this town stuffed in his pocket. And now his seat’s getting cold – waiting for my ass to sit on it.

King’s lapdog, Eduardo Reyes, aka Dollar Dragon.

A tough guy, gotta hand it to him. Held down his crew even after King died and got himself a juicy piece of the pie.

Someone I’ll have to crush, one way or another.

Back in the day he was this badass gangster, led his people with fury and passion. But after the dust of King’s conquest settled, he got comfortable and overly cautious. Means he became a pussy.

I think it’s time for a new generation to take over Rockay City.

King’s really had everything under his thumb. Literally.

Police. Mayor. City council. Heads of crime syndicates.

Even government-controlled buildings let the doors wide open for him.

Like that ancient king – everything he touched turned to gold. But that’s alright. I’ll be there soon, too.

Mine. Mine, mine, mine, mine, mine.

All the cool dudes had it – Al Capone and other great guys. And I’m gonna be up there with them once I get this city under my thumb.

And this gold’s gonna help me do it.

Now I like a pile of gold same as the next crook, but slowing down this asshole will be a nice bonus.

Sheriff wants to parade the gold in DC to show off how he’s faring here in Rockay - and get some more money for his department. That’d be trouble, we got enough cops as is.

How embarrassing it’ll be when we steal it right under his nose? Can already hear this dry-as-dust mother-fucker making excuses on Rockay news.

Now I’m not against cowboying our way inside, but we gotta look at this from every angle.

One of them could be through the roof. We’ll send our guy to fix their ventilation – and take a few photos while he’s at it.

Guard towers, shift changes – anything that’ll help us get inside.

That fucker, Dragon, invited me for a game of golf.

I’m not of fan of being too friendly with the opposition, but against Sheriff I’ll need all the hands I can get (or chop off).

The goal is pretty clear – get the location of King’s resting place and not get killed in the process.

The Rockay PD may call themselves protectors of the law, but they’re just another gang battling over control.

And I ain’t giving way. One way or another, the police will fall in line eventually.

But for now, a distraction will do. A good ol' slashing tires should slow them down. A trick I learned in elementary.

The ol' King’s got his paws everywhere – even in a government-controlled fucking depot. Seems like he used it for his own personal storage. Even had his dirty hand-print saved to override security control.

The other top-dog that’s got this privilege is none other than Sheriff. And I ain’t cuttin' off his hand (not now at least).

Grave-robbing it is, I guess…

The pigs are spread thin around Rockay as is - courtesy of yours truly. But Sheriff definitely shifted his focus to the depot, afraid to lose his salary raise.

We’ll see if he chooses it over the lives of innocent Rockay citizens…

We'll have to do this at the same day as the heist. And the crew on it won't be available for a while.

This gate looks pretty sturdy. Gotta ram it at full speed to break through.

There’s also the security that’ll be ready for us – we’ll be making a hell of a ruckus.

Careful with the guard towers, might have snipers inside.

All in all straight-forward, but fucking loud.

This is it, Fort Knox's (slightly less secure) little brother. And inside – a fortune callin' my name.

One access point, an army of guards, high-tech security measures and the Sheriff’s attention. That’s what’s standing between us and the treasure. Outta be a cake-walk.

Touchdown will be nagging, but somebody’s gotta put in the physical work and dig out the tunnel right to the depot. And I ain’t working with a shovel, not anymore.

It’s gotta be big enough for trucks to come through and stable enough not to fucking bury us.

We need to have this turf before we break into the depot. Digging a tunnel and planning a heist on enemy’s turf can get fucking complicated. Can’t have any surprises – this turf’s gotta be under my control. I’ll be taking it sooner or later anyway.

We noticed some crates going in and out of the depot, just big enough to fit a person. But we’ll need to know the exact crates we can use.

Nasara says he knows a guy – master of infiltration. A goddamn ninja. This ninja will get us all the shipping information.

Then we just Trojan horse ourselves, right through the front-fucking-door.
Who the fuck designed these?! Why can’t it go full-throttle without my input?!

King’s untimely death kicked off a gang war in Rockay City. Help Travis Baker defeat his opponents and secure the crown!

Make your strategic moves on the <BigEm>MAP</>, be it taking over territories or robbing banks.

<BigEm>DETECTIVES</> are the Sheriff's elite investigators. They effectively clear the territories from criminal activity. A cleared territory turns neutral after a day.

Getting loud during a mission in the vicinity of detectives attracts their attention. Killing a detective during a mission reduces <BigEm>INVESTIGATION</>.

<BigEm>MISSIONS</> are your main source of income. They differentiate in their type, risk, planning cost and reward.

As your <BigEm>RESPECT</> grows, the missions will become more dangerous with bigger rewards.
<BigEm>PLANNING BOARD</> illustrates your progress in the current story plotline. It also contains more detailed information and allows you to start the missions in question.

After most missions you see the debrief, where you can see how you finished the mission.

You can see the how much money and loot you brought, state of your heister and your star rating.

You can see more detail by clicking on More Details.

Assign the right team members for the upcoming mission.

Note the team’s gear, stats and mission cut.

Baker’s death means the end of the current run. But the game is far from over!

There’s still more heists and stories to discover. Choose your bonuses, improve your chances and try again!

Become a Rockay City legend by pulling off heists with your crew! Work together, climb the ranks, and make a name for yourself in the criminal underworld.

Try <BigEm>CUSTOMIZING</> your character in the <BigEm>BOSS</> tab to stand out—or blend in—and make sure you're ready for the next job!

Become a true <BigEm>BOSS</> by stealing and robbing together with your friends! Assemble the ultimate crew and heist your way to the top of Rockay City!

Go to the <BigEm>PLAY</> tab once you’re finished <BigEm>CUSTOMIZING</> your boss.

Careful, Sheriff’s <BigEm>INVESTIGATION</> into you is close to completion!

Once it’s complete, the police will attempt to strike you down.

Claiming an <BigEm>ENEMY TERRITORY</> requires that you defeat the enemy gang in combat. You can balance the amount of sent soldiers and spent money with a slider.

Attack the enemy territory.

Criminal activities raise the <BigEm>HEAT</>, making missions more dangerous. Heat drops at the start of a new day.

To stop your advance, the relentless Sheriff gradually collects more evidence – which is conveyed by <BigEm>INVESTIGATION</>.

Conquer Rockay City before Sheriff completes his investigation into your activities.

Customize your boss to your liking! Unlock new items, skins and more by <BigEm>LEVELING UP</>!

You retain all purchased unlockables even upon death in a mission.

Expanding your territory increases your <BigEm>RESPECT</>. 

With each respect level gained, you’ll have access to bigger rewards, better missions, stronger weapons, and new team members.

Increasing respect also gives boss experience, granting unlocks for various boss bonuses.

Experience Rockay City's <BigEm>URBAN LEGENDS</>! No holds barred cooperative mini-stories that can be played with bots and players alike.

Choose from a pre-selected pool of characters and try to succeed without replenished revives between missions.

Explore the standalone stories of unique individuals.

The completion of these missions is <BigEm>SAVED ACROSS RUNS</>, unless the team member dies outside of their character missions.

Finishing an urban legend unlocks the next one in the selection. Replay them to earn a better score and star rating.

Completing an urban legend with a three-star rating will give you a nice cash bonus on top.
In the <BigEm>ENTOURAGE</> tab you will find an overview of your closest advisors and their respective persistent bonuses – which you collect through raising your boss level.
In the <BigEm>OFFICE</> tab you can manage your financials – sell loot from your stash, take out a loan or buy assets to spruce up your office.

In the <BigEm>TEAM</> tab, you manage your team of specialists. You can change their gear, promote them, dismiss or hire new ones. Team members can be used for one mission per day. For each mission, they gain experience towards a <BigEm>PROMOTION</>.

Be careful – a team member’s death is <BigEm>PERMANENT</>!

In the Team tab you can acquire new <BigEm>TEAM MEMBERS</> to complete your crew.

Acquired team members are not lost upon their death.

Participating in criminal activities – such as robberies or attacking turfs – raises the <BigEm>HEAT</>. Raised heat signifies stronger response from the police.

The heat drops at the start of a new day.

Progressing in your run and buying assets earns you <BigEm>BOSS POINTS</> that contribute to a <BigEm>BOSS LEVEL</> up.

With each boss level, you can select one out of three persistent bonuses. These bonuses help you across all runs.

Purchasing <BigEm>ASSETS</> contributes to your <BigEm>BOSS POINTS</> gain while also decorating your office.

The assets stay in your possession across all runs.

Sending a team member on missions gives them experience – eventually qualifying them for <BigEm>PROMOTION</>.

Promotion increases overall stats, mission cut, adds perks and also equipment.

Stars influence hotness of the loot and money. Every missing star increases the fencing cost.

Acquiring stars:

1st star – Finish the main objective

2nd star – Clean execution – don’t kill civilians and don’t lose any heister

3rd star – Special objective – different smaller challenges, don’t forget to check them before the mission in the mission detail. During the mission you can see their state under the main objective

Stolen commodities, such as drugs and electronics, are stored in your <BigEm>STASH</>.

Sell them at the peak of their market value to gain a cash boost for your operation.

Or hold onto the commodities and discover their alternative uses.

Taking Baker to a mission grants you many advantages, such as <BigEm>BONUS REWARD</> with 0% mission cut and completing two missions a day.

Beware that Baker’s death results in the <BigEm>END OF THE RUN</>.

Test your heisting skills to the fullest in a randomized sequence of missions – <BigEm>SHUFFLE</>!

Overcome all missions in the sequence and get a hefty bonus on top of the regular mission rewards. The longer tiers come with superior prizes. However, their missions may prove to be more challenging.

There are different ways to conquer Rockay City. Some available missions do not give you financial rewards. 

Instead, completing them helps you in turf war – by weakening the rival boss or taking over enemy territory.

To avoid running out of cash, consider taking out a <BigEm>LOAN</>.

Notice the loan repayment conditions to avoid complete bankruptcy.

Welcome to <BigEm>ROCKAY RUMBLE</>! Step into the seasonal arena armed with the fiercest combat perks, choose your weapon of glory, and prepare for waves of enemies hungry for defeat. 

Kill enemies – collect rewards – earn shop tokens – spend tokens on upgrades. 

Co-operate, adapt, <BigEm>SURVIVE</>… Because only the strongest make it out of <BigEm>ROCKAY RUMBLE</>!
Well done, Boss! You have reached <BigEm>PRESTIGE</> level <BigEm>BRONZE</>. Complete more jobs and level up to reach the next tier.

When your resources  are depleted (such as available team members and army), <BigEm>END THE DAY</>.

Ending the day refreshes your team, army and the heat from police. It also lets your enemies make their move.

You <BigEm>LEVEL UP</> by playing missions and gaining XP points.

With every level you unlock new items, skins and more which can then be bought in <BigEm>CAMPAIGN</> and <BigEm>MULTIPLAYER</>.

You can claim a <BigEm>NEUTRAL TERRITORY</> for yourself by sending soldiers and spending money.

Claim your first territory.

You can claim a neutral turf for yourself by spending soldiers and money.

Claim your first turf.

You have unlocked all purchasable items from the progression system. Any future level-ups will grant a substantial amount of money for your Co-Op Boss. When new unlockable content is introduced in future updates, you will automatically receive the corresponding magazines.

You receive rewards for each successful mission you complete, even if you ultimately fail before reaching the end of the round.

However, if you are successful, you obtain additional money.

Your <BigEm>SOLDIERS</> are essential in turf war. They die and are spent during attacks and defense.

<BigEm>HIRE</> more soldiers to keep expanding.

Your primary goal is to conquer Rockay City, but there are many ways to get closer to the crown.

The <BigEm>GOALS</> tab allows you to select and keep track of your short-term objectives.

Your property is under attack! A rival gang is attempting to steal cash and resources from turfs under your protection.

<BigEm>DEFEND</> your property. By doing it well, you may put a dent into the enemy forces.

Complete the special objective to <BigEm>LOWER ARMY TIER</> of the attacking gang (if possible).

Ignoring or losing the <BigEm>DEFENSE</> gives the territory to the enemy.
